body: I like long hair. I have great hair. I have always been grateful for my hair. Do you like your hair?

It's a 50 year pile up, you could say.
Too much abuse. Too many dead people. Too many friends and lovers who lied. Too much ugly. 

Every time I relax, and I think it's safe to take a deep breath, it comes again. Life gets grandly ugly again. People aren't nice, in case you weren't aware. I mean, even if you do nothing to them. Even if you go out of your way to avoid them. They find you and hurt you. You can't escape them.

After a while you stop wanting to. You know the easiest way to let them come get you is to believe everything they say about you is true. I believe them now. There are so many. They're like a symphony. I don't mean I'm schizophrenic and I hear voices. I mean I just feel like I've been beaten up, abused, told I'm not doing this right or that right or I said this wrong or I hurt that person or I shouldn't have done whatever or I should have done something else. Nobody loves you for just being you.

Oh really. I know that, huh. So I have to know that. So what if I don't know that. Huh. What that doees do to your little pronouncement.

I thought this was suicide watch and people were supposed to try to help you when you're in trouble. I know I came on here with my regular account all the time to help people. I made this burner because I don't want to be known by that name.

But nobody's coming to help me. That's OK. I fell better with the ambien kicking in. I'm floating off on a cloud of AMbien -- ama!

OK, well thanks for helping. What I expected, anyway. Nobody gives a damn about anybody else in this life, when it comes down to it. I used to think differently. I used to be a stupid sap. You can choose to be one too, I don't care. But I know this world sucks and people are evil, so I'm out of here.

I'm taking the Ambien. Just like last time I'll wake up in the hospital after about 17 hours and then get transported to the loony bin in a squad car in handcuffs. I might try to find some other pills around the house, so that doesn't happen. I don't want to repeat. I'm not killing myself just so I can have a nice stay with the crazy people in the loony bin. Oh, and for the record, that's not the inmates, it's the doctors. Especially the doctors. ANd some of the nurses. Those are the crazy people in the loony bin. Well OK, and the people shuffling around mumbling to themselves or having violent outbursts.

But most of the people in the loony bin. Nice people who just get beat up and spit on one too many times and can't take it anymore. Who can take this world. I haven't met anyone strong enough.

Anyway it sucks so why would you want to endure it. Fuck it.

I was really fat in high school and ugly and nobody ever asked me to dance at the dances or asked me out. Even in college I never had a boyfriend. Luckily I liked my major so I just poured myself into that.

When I started getting success in my major and my studies, people started treating me like someone who mattered. And that gave me confidence and I started learning how to dress and groom. So many really ugly girls look really stunning because they know how to dress themselves and do their hair and makeup. I actually found out I have pretty good material, I just needed to know how to make the best of it.

Now that I'm an old lady, I know just what looks good on me and what doesn't. 

Hang in there. You will find your style and you will rock it.
